ReturnPolicyPage.metaDescription: Right of withdrawal on distance sales: 14 days to return an item, no questions asked, under Portuguese Decree-Law 24/2014. See how to return a purchase.
ReturnPolicyPage.title: Return policy.
ReturnPolicyPage.subtitle: Right of withdrawal on distance sales — 14 days, no questions asked.

sections.title: Right of withdrawal
sections.body: For purchases made remotely (online, WhatsApp, email), you have 14 days from the delivery date to return the product without giving a reason, in accordance with Portuguese Decree-Law no. 24/2014.

sections.title: How to return
sections.body: Notify us of your intention to return by email (reddunesolutions@gmail.com) or WhatsApp. Pack the product in its original packaging, with all accessories. You have a further 14 days to drop it off or send it back.

sections.title: Condition of the product
sections.body: The product must be in the same condition as delivered: no signs of use, with all accessories, manuals and original packaging. Installed software, activated licences and irreversible personalisations may affect the refund value.

sections.title: Return costs
sections.body: Return shipping costs are the customer's responsibility, except if the product is defective or non-conforming — in which case we cover the collection cost.

sections.title: Refund
sections.body: We refund the full amount paid (including original shipping) through the same payment method, within 14 days of receiving the product and validating its condition.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.body: We do not accept returns of: bespoke products (custom builds to client spec), software with an activated licence, opened consumable products (cables cut to size), and promotional offers identified as non-refundable.

sections.title: In-store purchases
sections.body: For in-store (non-distance) purchases, the legal warranties under DL 84/2021 apply, but there is no automatic right of withdrawal — any exchange is at RedDune Solutions's discretion.

ReturnPolicyPage.closingBody: Contact us via WhatsApp or email to get started. Reply within 24h.

PrivacyPolicyPage.section2P1: The Personal Data Protection Law and the General Data Protection Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016, hereinafter "GDPR") guarantee protection regarding the processing of personal data and the free movement of such data.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section2P2: Under the law, "personal data" is considered to be any and all information (including sound and image) relating to an identified or identifiable natural person; protection does not extend to data of legal persons.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section2P3: By providing your personal data through the website https://www.reddunesolutions.pt/, namely by filling in forms or by contacting us, the user declares that this information is provided freely, in an informed and explicit manner, authorising its collection and processing under the terms described herein.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section2P4: Reddune Solutions undertakes to process users' personal data with full transparency and responsibility, in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation and other applicable legislation.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section2P5: Users may, at any time, withdraw their consent without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out on the basis of consent previously given. To do so, they should contact us through the means available on this website.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section2P6: If you do not agree with the terms of this Privacy Policy, we recommend that you do not use this site or provide any personal data.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section3Intro: Personal data collected by Reddune Solutions is processed solely and exclusively for the following purposes:
PrivacyPolicyPage.section3Item1: Execution and management of sales contracts or service provision;
PrivacyPolicyPage.section3Item3: Management of contacts and information requests;
PrivacyPolicyPage.section3Item8: Improvement of the website and user experience through the analysis of navigation data, statistics and site usage.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section3Outro: Reddune Solutions guarantees the confidentiality of all data provided by its clients and undertakes not to use such data for purposes other than those described above, except where there is new consent from the user or a legal obligation permitting it.
PrivacyPolicyPage.section4P1: Reddune Solutions retains your personal data only for the period strictly necessary to fulfil the purpose for which it was collected. Once this retention period has elapsed, Reddune Solutions ensures that your personal data is deleted.
PrivacyPolicyPage.closingBody: We are available to clarify any doubts about the processing of your personal data or to help you exercise your rights under the GDPR.

FaqPage.metaTitle: FAQ: IT Services in the Algarve | RedDune Solutions
FaqPage.metaDescription: Questions about tech support, the shop, websites or data recovery in the Algarve? Straight answers from the RedDune team — and easy contact if any is missing.
FaqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FaqPage.subtitle: We've gathered the most common questions about our services. Can't find what you're looking for? Get in touch — we answer everything.

items.a: We work across four areas: tech support (repairs, cleaning, upgrades and PC builds), an IT equipment shop, web and software development (websites, online stores and custom systems) and data recovery. You can see the detail of each area on the [Services page](/servicos).

items.q: Do you offer on-site support or only in-store?
items.a: We do both. You can bring your equipment in or, whenever it makes sense, we can come to you. Call-outs have a per-kilometre cost from Fuseta, which we always confirm before going ahead.

items.q: How does a quote work? Is it free?
items.a: Quotes are free and with no obligation. For repairs, we run a diagnosis first to understand the fault and only proceed with your approval. No work is ever charged without prior authorisation.

items.q: How long does a repair take?
items.a: It depends on the type of fault and parts availability. We always give an estimate in the quote and, when you need something faster, we can assess an urgent service subject to availability (with an additional fee).

items.q: Can you recover data from a faulty drive?
items.a: In most cases of logical failure (accidental formatting, corrupted drive, deleted files), yes — see our [data recovery service](/servicos/software-recuperacao). Physical failures requiring a clean room are referred to certified partner labs. We run a diagnosis before any commitment and always keep your data confidential.

Yes. We advise on parts according to the intended use (office, gaming, professional work) and your available budget, ensuring compatibility and balance between components. We handle the build, system installation and testing before delivery.

items.q: Do you also sell equipment and components?
items.a: Yes, we have an IT equipment and components shop. You can browse part of the range on the [Shop page](/loja); for specific requests or advice, just get in touch.

items.q: Do you build websites and custom software?
items.a: Yes. We develop everything from landing pages and brochure sites to online stores and custom systems — see our [web design service](/servicos/web-digital). Every project starts with a conversation to understand your business goal before we present a detailed quote.

items.q: Do your services come with a warranty?
items.a: Yes. Repairs are covered by a warranty on labour, and parts follow the respective manufacturer's warranty. The specific terms are stated in the quote or invoice for each service.
We are based in Fuseta and mainly serve the Algarve. For online services (websites, software, consulting) we work without geographical limits. If you're unsure about your area, just get in touch.
You can reach us via WhatsApp, phone or email, or use the form on the [Contact page](/contacto). We reply as quickly as possible and help you figure out the best path for your case.

FaqPage.closingBody: Every case is different. Tell us what you need and we'll give you a clear answer, with no obligation.
